fields.reportedAt: Nov 4, 2026, 03:05, to the Miami field office
fields.summary: Guest A, a US national, travelling with Guest B, was reported missing by Guest B at 02:14. A camera shows Guest A at the aft rail at 01:51. A search is under way and the ship has turned back along its track.
steps: Camera recordings for Decks 11 and 12 secured from 01:00
Cabin sealed and key card log pulled
Coast Guard rescue coordination center informed at 02:20
Guest B interviewed by the Security Officer with a staff member present
fields.dotFiling: To be filed on the Department of Transportation website after the telephone report
fields.contact: Security Officer, bridge line 7-1300; Shoreside security desk (555) 010-4410
